Task: 001 — Assistant foundation
Linked: dev/milestones/v0.7-assistant/001-assistant-foundation.md
Preview: https://e8ccb71b-tenboards-preview.mohanadgh.workers.dev
Alias: https://pr-68-tenboards-preview.mohanadgh.workers.dev (ASSETS-only; no secrets).

Stack: first layer based on main 3703f76 (v0.6.2). Merge order 001 → 002 → 003. [Layer compare](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/compare/main...feat/v0.7/001-assistant-foundation).

### Acceptance criteria

- [x] `/dashboard/assistant` renders in the current shell, inherits `requireAppRoute` protection/session refresh, and sits immediately after Chat in desktop, collapsed-icon and mobile nav. Palette/header/capture registry agree; existing standalone and embedded Chat are unchanged.
- [x] Exact OpenUI pins and lockfile are committed; existing React/Zod peers resolve, no react-ui/headless/CLI/server/Gateway/native SDK dependency is added. Record dependency tree and before/after client/Worker build sizes; unused devtools/observability are not activated. No telemetry or external network request in recorded mode.
- [x] Registry contains bounded root/stack, escaped text, cards, stats, badges, lists, tables and simple bar/line charts composed from existing wrappers/theme. Strict Zod schemas enforce finite data, text/array limits and application-owned enums; chart alternatives and reduced-motion behavior match DESIGN.
- [x] Registered names/prop schemas produce one serializable spec and library prompt, with drift detection; server-use imports exclude React/render components. Match the pinned package's real API rather than copying a newer docs example blindly.
- [x] Every node's evaluated props are independently validated before rendering; enforce milestone depth/node/row/point limits, reject unknown names and unsupported expressions/actions/Query/Mutation. No DOM spreading, raw HTML, iframe, script, dynamic evaluation, arbitrary CSS, URL/link prop or generated form. The safety boundary holds for intermediate as well as final output.
- [x] Recorded samples cover every allowed component using synthetic illustrative data and the versioned text-delta/finish/error envelope. Select an example or submit a prompt to receive an explicitly labeled recorded reply; unmatched input gets an honest recorded fallback, never pretends to call a model. Same incremental decoder/renderer source seam will accept 002 streams.
- [x] Provide a minimal working composer and transient transcript with visible empty/loading/completed/incomplete/error states; recorded generation is cancellable and cleans up on unmount. No storage, cookie or URL transcript. SSR/client initial state agrees; browser APIs stay in effects/guarded code, no `use client` directive.
- [x] Incremental split tokens/UTF-8, malformed/unknown/deep/oversized output and error-boundary recovery tests pass without exposing unsafe partial content or crashing the page. Error messages contain no raw payloads. Parser/schema tests are behavior-focused, not snapshots of implementation internals.
- [x] Keyboard names/focus, Enter versus Shift+Enter/IME, mobile composer and local table scrolling, token pairs and reduced motion pass. Capture/inspect before/after Assistant shell context plus unchanged Chat/default in light/dark × desktop/mobile; no hydration/console errors.
- [x] README explains this layer's recorded-only availability, and status reflects verified work only. Version preview is ASSETS-only `tenboards-preview`; no real credentials or provider calls.


### Files touched
- Route-local Assistant, validated registry/spec/language gate and recorded SSE transport.
- Navigation/catalog and generated route tree: insert Assistant immediately after Chat.
- Exact OpenUI package pins/lockfile, adversarial/browser tests and test-port isolation.
- README: updated (status, local setup, commands); CHANGELOG, DESIGN, task status and Assistant surface brief.

### Tests
- `npm run build`, `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`: pass. Check reports 0 errors, 19 warnings, 10 infos. New nonblocking warnings: intentional bounded-array keys, class order, conditional style; inherited: realtime-visitors, analytics, highlighter. Existing build chunk-size/export diagnostics remain warnings.
- `npm run assistant:test`: 1,047 assertions plus six reachable/unreachable reference expansion attacks (10^6–10^8), each under 250ms.
- `npm run assistant:browser`: light/dark × desktop/mobile pass; all recorded components, independent evaluated-prop rejection, registry drift, keyboard/IME/focus, stopped/clear race, error-boundary recovery, no persistence/overflow/console errors.
- `npm run screenshots -- --base-url http://127.0.0.1:3170 --routes /dashboard/assistant,/dashboard/default,/dashboard/chat,/chat`: all 16 final captures pass, including default dev smoke.
- `TEST_PORT_OFFSET=160 npm run auth:test`: 12 suites / 430 scenarios pass, including Assistant anonymous/valid/expired/revoked route and refresh. `TEST_SENTINEL_PORT=3179` foundation rerun 31/31. `data:parity`: 104/104. `worker:test`, `worker:auth`, `worker:security`: pass on actual local workerd, isolated Postgres `tenboards_v07_tests` at 3188. No other agent's DB/ports used.
- Network checks find no Assistant/provider/telemetry egress; the harness exempts pre-existing Google font hosts. Preview verified recorded and remote inventory exactly ASSETS; no real keys or paid calls.
- Raw/gzip totals: client 3,054,297/915,205 → 3,179,812/957,065 bytes; Worker 8,049,400/1,772,048 → 8,278,787/1,834,200. Preview upload 8,084.75 KiB / 1,721.80 KiB gzip, startup 2ms.
- Original failed runs remain in evidence: pre-hydration click race fixed in test; one transient embedded-Chat fetch recaptured successfully in all four modes; temporary missing chart imports and nested test-component lint error fixed. No unresolved failures.

Evidence: [review-tests.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/review-tests.log), [review-browser.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/review-browser.log), [review-build.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/review-build.log), [check-final.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/check-final.log), [review-typecheck.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/review-typecheck.log), [auth-rerun.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/auth-rerun.log), [parity.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/parity.log), [worker.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/worker.log), [worker-auth.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/worker-auth.log), [worker-security.log](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/worker-security.log), [dependencies.txt](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/dependencies.txt).

[Full interaction evidence](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/blob/pr-assets/v0.7/001/interaction) includes streaming/stopped focus, mobile sheet/icon-collapse and palette. `*-error.png` is a development-only renderer-boundary probe, not a product error screenshot. The existing TanStack dev overlay appears in local captures, absent in the preview. No token changes; existing supported semantic pairs reused. Impeccable detector returned `[]`; Claude Opus 5.5 finish round 2 verdict: **ship**, no high/medium findings.

### Decisions
PLAN v0.7, v0.6.2 compact density and v0.7/v0.8 sequencing apply. Scoped prefactors isolate pure schemas/spec and a bounded source-neutral stream decoder. OpenUI inspector bootstrap and renderer observability are disabled. Test port offsets preserve default suite behavior and isolate this worktree. Other runtime dependencies are unchanged. Claude owns review and merge; implementer never merges or deploys production.
